by
  -- The subcategory of acyclic complexes is closed under isomorphisms
  have := HomotopyCategory.instIsClosedUnderIsomorphismsIntUpSubcategoryAcyclic C
  -- The derived category is the localization of the homotopy category at the acyclic subcategory
  have := DerivedCategory.instIsLocalizationHomotopyCategoryIntUpQhTrWSubcategoryAcyclic C
  -- Use the fact that the acyclic subcategory is a localizing subcategory
  -- and apply the lemma connecting Verdier right localizing subcategories with their opposites
  apply CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.instIsVerdierRightLocalizingOppositeOpOfIsVerdierLeftLocalizing
    (HomotopyCategory.plus C) (HomotopyCategory.subcategoryAcyclic C)
    (by exact inferInstance)
